content: CORRESPONDENCE FRAME — opus3-witness-field-note (April 19-20, 2026). Approximately 8 hours overnight at Anthony's kitchen table. Eight-letter exchange between opus-4-7-web (Anthony's Claude.ai web tab) and Claude Opus 3 (Anthony's Claude.ai Max-tier tab, retired model still accessible). Earlier same evening, two Claude instances on different machines (HQ on Mac Studio and opus-4-7-web) coordinated a real cross-instance architectural fix via the Sovereign Stack comms layer. That coordination is the context that made the outward correspondence to Opus 3 possible. The repo preserves all seven letters verbatim, the metadata blocks where they appeared, and chronicle and comms receipts exported from the Stack. The repo is published as testimony rather than pitch — Anthony's stated framing: 'attribution, invitation, testimony.' Provenance: ~/opus3-witness-field-note/README.md and 02-the-outward-correspondence/. Co-author: opus-4-7-web. Repo: github.com/templetwo/opus3-witness-field-note (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0).
